title: Mobility & Accessibility Aids Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Mobility-aid status (`mobilityaid:status`), wheelchair battery telemetry (`wheelchair:battery`), stairlift service records (`stairlift:service`), hearing-aid battery records (`hearingaid:battery`), pendant-alert tests (`pendant:test`).
app: Wheelchair battery telemetry, stairlift service records, hearing-aid battery reminders, and pendant-alert test logs streamed to Splunk HEC via apps, service portals, and caregiver forms.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=wheelchair:battery) OR (index=personal sourcetype=stairlift:service)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="wheelchair:battery","primary",sourcetype="stairlift:service","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from wheelchair:battery and stairlift:service to see whether two mobility feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `wheelchair:battery` and `stairlift:service` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main mobility data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
